commands.name: check-references
commands.description: Checks centrally managed packages against referenced packages for .csproj files

arguments.name: VALUE
arguments.description: The path to a directory containing a 'Directory.Packages.props' file and .NET projects. If none is specified, the current directory will be used.

commands.name: compare-references
commands.description: Checks centrally managed packages files against another that is located in a related repository

options.name: --compare
options.description: The path to a directory containing a 'Directory.Packages.props' file. The path should exist and contain a 'Directory.Packages.props' file.

arguments.name: VALUE
arguments.description: The path to a directory containing a 'Directory.Packages.props' file. If none is specified, the current directory will be used.

commands.name: align-versions
commands.description: Aligns centrally managed package versions with those that is located in another repository

options.name: --align
options.description: The path to a directory containing a 'Directory.Packages.props' file. The path should exist and contain a 'Directory.Packages.props' file.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report updates only - no .props will be updated.

arguments.name: VALUE
arguments.description: The path to a directory containing a 'Directory.Packages.props' file. If none is specified, the current directory will be used.
